scope: Post-trial and post-judgment slice of a US federal civil money dispute, and the financing instruments whose terms it triggers, bounded by what decides the lender's collections: a petition (11 U.S.C. §362) or too little cash above operating need on a due date. Chains are templates by forum and instrument; the case fills them through the agent's instantiated objects (the dispute, its components and the financing instruments). Appellate merits are never forecast.
design: Stage order: legal decision map (templates), then clocks and parameters (each with one disposition: Law, Record, Data, Arithmetic, Bounded or Jev), then path arithmetic. Jev answers only the residual questions: one actor's decision given the path facts code computes and the record items the agent supplies. Timing, amounts, affordability, enforceability and legal meaning are code or Law. Readings are evidence routed to the questions, never their probability. Only impossibility changes structure: an event that has occurred, a payment, or arithmetic that rules a branch out on every trajectory of the path.

roles.agent: Groups the accepted findings about one obligation and gives its order reference (a docket reference, checked), its nature (from `natures`), the counterparty, the amount figure (checked against the quotes) and any judgment date (checked against the quotes). Its prose never reaches Jev.
roles.jev: Answers present-state and conditional forecast questions. Never sets a date, an amount or a path.
roles.host: Hydrates evidence, asks the questions, applies the stage rules, composes probabilities, simulates cash.

probability_label: Model judgment: Jev's conditional probabilities of defined future events, composed along each path by code.

natures.fee_and_cost_award: an award of attorneys' fees and costs

frcp_62a.citation: Fed. R. Civ. P. 62(a): "execution on a judgment and proceedings to enforce it are stayed for 30 days after its entry, unless the court orders otherwise."

frcp_62b.citation: Fed. R. Civ. P. 62(b): a party may obtain a stay by providing a bond or other security; "The stay takes effect when the court approves the bond or other security".

frap_4a1a.citation: Fed. R. App. P. 4(a)(1)(A): notice of appeal within 30 days after entry of the judgment or order.

frap_4a4a.citation: Fed. R. App. P. 4(a)(4)(A): a timely motion under Rule 50(b), 52(b), 59 (alter or amend; new trial), or Rule 54 fees only where the court extends time under Rule 58(e), makes the time to appeal run from the order disposing of the last such remaining motion.

frcp_69a.citation: Fed. R. Civ. P. 69(a)(1): a money judgment is enforced by a writ of execution; the procedure must accord with the procedure of the state where the court is located.

usc28_1963.citation: 28 U.S.C. §1963: a judgment may be registered in another district "when the judgment has become final by appeal or expiration of the time for appeal or when ordered by the court that entered the judgment for good cause shown." Good cause: thin forum assets and substantial assets elsewhere (Associated Bus. Tel. Sys. v. Greater Capital Corp., 128 F.R.D. 63, 66-68 (D.N.J. 1989)).
usc28_1963.modality: may, after finality or on good cause

usc28_1961.citation: 28 U.S.C. §1961(a)-(b): interest from the date of entry of the judgment at the weekly average 1-year constant maturity Treasury yield for the calendar week preceding the judgment, computed daily, compounded annually. Increases by an amended judgment run from the amended date; a remitted amount keeps the original date (Kaiser Aluminum v. Bonjorno, 494 U.S. 827 (1990); Dunn v. HOVIC, 13 F.3d 58, 60-62 (3d Cir. 1993)); fees run from the judgment quantifying them (Eaves v. County of Cape May, 239 F.3d 527 (3d Cir. 2001)).
usc28_1961.rate_source: FRED WGS1YR (H.15 weekly), week ending 17 May 2024: 5.14%

nc_24_1.citation: N.C. Gen. Stat. §24-1: "The legal rate of interest shall be eight percent (8%) per annum".

nc_24_5_b.citation: N.C. Gen. Stat. §24-5(b): in an action other than contract, "any portion of a money judgment designated by the fact finder as compensatory damages bears interest from the date the action is commenced until the judgment is satisfied." Commencement is the original complaint even when the claim was added by amendment (Beach Mart, Inc. v. L&L Wings, Inc. (E.D.N.C. Mar. 26, 2021); STAGE3 L1). None on exemplary damages.
nc_24_5_b.modality: shall on compensatory; whether unjust enrichment is compensatory is open (J6)

nc_66_154_d.citation: N.C. Gen. Stat. §66-154(d): if willful and malicious misappropriation exists, "the court may award reasonable attorneys' fees to the prevailing party."

usc18_1836_b3d.citation: 18 U.S.C. §1836(b)(3)(D): if the trade secret was willfully and maliciously misappropriated, the court may award reasonable attorney's fees to the prevailing party. §1836(b)(3)(C): exemplary damages up to 2 times the damages awarded.

nc_75_16.citation: N.C. Gen. Stat. §75-16: once a violation of §75-1.1 is found, "judgment shall be rendered ... for treble the amount fixed by the verdict." Election between trebled and punitive recovery: United Labs. v. Kuykendall, 335 N.C. 183 (1993) (code takes the larger).
nc_75_16.modality: shall, once a violation exists; whether one exists over the jury's answer is open (J4)

nc_1d.citation: N.C. Gen. Stat. §§1D-15(a), 1D-25(b): punitive damages capped at the greater of 3 times compensatory damages or $250,000; they depend on compensatory damages, so a new trial on compensatory damages takes the exemplary award (Carawan v. Tate, 304 N.C. 696 (1982); Shaver; Gasoline Prods. v. Champlin, 283 U.S. 494 (1931); STAGE3 L4).

remittitur.citation: Remittitur is to the maximum the evidence supports, and the plaintiff may refuse it and take a new trial (Hetzel v. Prince William County, 523 U.S. 208 (1998); Kazan v. Wolinski, 721 F.2d 911 (3d Cir. 1983)).

jmol_standard.citation: Fed. R. Civ. P. 50(b); JMOL only where the record lacks the minimum evidence to support the verdict (Lightning Lube v. Witco, 4 F.3d 1153, 1166 (3d Cir. 1993)).

bond_amount.citation: A supersedeas bond normally secures "the whole amount of the judgment remaining unsatisfied, costs on the appeal, interest, and damages for delay" (Southern Track & Pump, Inc. v. Terex Corp., C.A. No. 08-543-LPS (D. Del.), quoting Poplar Grove Planting & Ref. Co. v. Bache Halsey Stuart, 600 F.2d 1189, 1191 (5th Cir. 1979)); D. Del. has no local multiple (RESEARCH R2h). Reduced or alternative security needs good cause (the Dillon/Poplar Grove line).
bond_amount.unit: bps of path judgment + interest + costs

usc11_362.citation: 11 U.S.C. §362(a): a petition operates as a stay of collection of pre-petition claims; the lender's collections stop on the petition date.

usc11_303b.citation: 11 U.S.C. §303(b)(1): with 12 or more creditors an involuntary petition needs three or more petitioning creditors holding noncontingent, undisputed claims above the statutory threshold; one judgment creditor cannot file alone (DECOMPOSITION L13).

usc11_547.citation: 11 U.S.C. §547(b): transfers to a creditor within 90 days before the petition are avoidable; §547(c)(4) new value given after the transfer reduces exposure. §547(c)(2) ordinary course is not computed.

amount_status_labels.sought: sought by a party, not fixed
amount_status_labels.estimated: estimated by a party, not fixed

events.injunction_entered: the court has entered an injunction in this dispute

readings.stage_rules_note: The stage is the most advanced procedural event any cited passage establishes, in the order listed. Pending post-trial motions place an entered judgment in post_trial: execution may issue (Rule 62(a) permitting) but the amount can still change and the appeal clock is tolled (FRAP 4(a)(4)(A)). A decision on every such motion moves it to judgment_entered. No established event leaves the dispute outside the model, with an evidence request.

amount_finality.label: How final the amount is
amount_finality.relevance: Does the quoted text say how far this obligation's amount has progressed (claimed, briefed or submitted for decision, fixed)?
levels: No amount has been stated
An amount is claimed or requested by a party
The amount has been fully briefed or submitted to the court for decision
The court has fixed the amount

appeal_intent.label: The payer's appeal intent
appeal_intent.relevance: Does the quoted text say whether the payer will appeal this obligation?
levels: The payer accepts the judgment or says it will not appeal
The passage states no position on an appeal
The payer is considering or reserves the right to appeal
The payer states it intends to appeal
appeal_intent.note: A filed notice of appeal is the procedural event appeal_filed, not a level of intent.

appeal_barred.label: An appeal of this obligation is waived or barred
appeal_barred.relevance: Does the quoted text state that the payer waived, or is barred from, appealing this obligation itself (not some other claim or order)?

debtor_resistance.label: The payer's willingness to pay this obligation
debtor_resistance.relevance: Does the quoted text describe whether the payer has paid, or refused to pay, an amount due under this obligation, or resisted its collection? Contesting the amount in court, appealing, or stating an intention to appeal is not refusal to pay: answer no for a passage that describes only those.
levels: The payer paid amounts due under this obligation when they fell due
The passage describes no payment conduct by the payer on this obligation
The payer paid late, or only after a motion or an enforcement step by the payee
The payer has refused to pay an amount that is due, or has resisted its collection
debtor_resistance.note: One dimension: the timeliness of the payer's payment conduct relative to when payment fell due. The court order that creates the obligation is not itself a compulsion to pay.

debtor_liquidity.label: The payer's ability to fund this obligation
debtor_liquidity.relevance: Does the quoted text say whether the payer can fund this obligation: its cash, its financing, or a statement about its ability to pay an amount of this size?
levels: The text indicates the payer cannot fund this obligation
The text indicates the payer could fund it only with strain (new financing, asset sales or cuts to operations)
The text indicates the payer can fund it without strain
debtor_liquidity.payer_note: Asked only when the counterparty pays. When the borrower pays, its available cash comes from the connected-bank data and is given to the forecasts directly.

settlement_signals.label: Settlement signals
settlement_signals.relevance: Does the quoted text say anything about the parties' willingness or efforts to settle this obligation, including a refusal to settle or failed talks?
levels: A party refuses to settle, or settlement talks have failed
The passage describes no settlement discussion
A party expresses general willingness to settle
The parties disclose active settlement negotiations
The parties have an agreement in principle or a term sheet

outcomes.settled: Settlement paid at the D5 bound on its date; the dispute ends.
outcomes.paid: Paid on the enforceable date: the path amount plus statutory interest.
outcomes.vacated: No money survives the post-trial ruling.
outcomes.new_trial: A new trial ordered: no money on that component in the horizon.
outcomes.levied: An unstayed levy takes min(owed, reachable cash) on the levy date.
outcomes.stayed: Execution stayed on approved security; collateral locked only where the path can fund it.
outcomes.unresolved: No final judgment in the horizon on that trajectory: the judgment as entered stays enforceable.
outcomes.uncollected: Enforceable and unpaid at the horizon, no levy: no cash.
outcomes.reorganization: A petition (voluntary or involuntary) on that trajectory's date: collections stop (§362).

dependence: One path is one sequence of residual decisions along the chain templates, in the order of the chains; each decision is conditional on the earlier ones on the path. Dates are drawn per trajectory by code, keyed (instance, node, purpose), independently of every probability; a decision takes effect only on trajectories where its condition holds on its date. Components compose by the chain rule into the ruling's outcome classes. Jev nodes are keyed by the facts their question depends on (interval, amount class, stay and notes status), so paths that share those facts share one judgment.
constraints: Only impossibility changes structure: an occurred event sets the stage, a payment ends the dispute, and arithmetic removes a branch only when it is impossible on every trajectory of the path. Everything else is a fact or evidence for a question. A low probability never removes a path.

forum.supplied_by: agent (instantiate_dispute), code-checked against the quoted passages
forum.note: Only the court template is built in 4.0.0. The arbitration template (AAA Commercial Rules award timing; FAA §§9, 10, 12; stages claims_pending, award_pending, award_issued) lands with Charles & Colvard.

fields.unknown: true when the record gives no amount and no rule computes one (a typed unknown, never 0)

components_schema.checks: Every amount_cents appears in a cited quote; a statutory component names a rule in `rules`; a component is exactly one of amount_cents, statutory or unknown.

ruling_lag_days.basis: Days from the close of briefing to the ruling on this judge's fully briefed matters on this docket, entries on or before the decision date (D. Del. 1:21-cv-1417, RESEARCH R4; n = 10, median 61.5).
ruling_lag_days.draw: one lag per pending motion, drawn uniformly from the sample, independent across motions and of every probability; the motion is decided on briefing close + lag
ruling_lag_days.sensitivity: one common lag for every motion

briefing_days_new_motion.basis: D. Del. LR 7.1.2(b): answering brief 14 days after the opening brief, reply 7 days after the answer; a motion filed on day t closes briefing on t + 21 and is decided on that date + a ruling_lag_days draw.

levy_lag_days.basis: Days from the enforcement decision (with the judgment registered where cash sits) to the levy.

petition_lag_days.basis: Days from a decision to file to the petition.

holder_notice_lag_days.basis: Days from a ripe default to the holders' notice and acceleration.

stay_restart_on_increase_days.basis: L8(a): an amended judgment restarts Rule 62(a) only for increases (base); sensitivity: the whole amended amount waits 30 days.

bond_forward_interest_years.basis: L7: the bond covers the path judgment, accrued §1961 interest and forward interest over the appeal; no costs were filed by the decision date.

bond_collateral_share_bps.basis: Surety practice for a borrower below investment grade: full cash collateral (RESEARCH R2i); the lower bound is Bounded.

reachable_before_registration.basis: L9: cash reachable by a levy before registration where the cash sits. Base: none. Sensitivity: all consolidated cash.

levy_scope.basis: A levy after registration reaches consolidated cash, whatever the operating need (lender-conservative on the judgment debtor's entity).

settlement_date_in_interval.basis: D5: a settlement agreed in an interval pays on interval start + 30 days; sensitivity at interval end.

cash_floor.basis: Spec §2.2: tau is the first date available cash falls below operating need (the collection rule's need); sensitivity: below zero.

form25_after_panel_days.basis: L12: "not listed" at suspension (base); sensitivity Form 25 effectiveness at panel decision + 60 (Rule 5820 windows) + 10 (17 C.F.R. §240.12d2-2(d)(1)); with no hearing, suspension + 10.

suspension_after_determination_days.basis: Nasdaq Rule 5815(a): a timely hearing request stays suspension; without one, suspension follows the Staff Determination after the 7-day request window (R2d).

panel_decision_days.basis: Panel decision after the Staff Determination (R2d).

repurchase_date.basis: Fundamental Change repurchase: notice within 20 business days, repurchase 20-35 business days after notice (indenture §10.01). Base: latest date; sensitivity: earliest.

coupon_cash_share.basis: Indenture §16.02(c): interest is paid in shares unless the company elects cash. Base: shares (no cash). Sensitivities: the June 2024 split ($0.442M of $1.32M) and all cash.

chips_credit_cents.basis: 13 May 2024 call: refundable CHIPS ITC of $2.8M-$4.0M "over the next 9 to 12 months", no date; paid through the FY2024 return (26 U.S.C. §48D(d)). Base $0 in the horizon; sensitivity $2.33M prorated June-December (inside the sourced $1.38M-$2.63M).

legal_fee_spend.basis: Legal spend in the feed continues until the dispute resolves on the path (payment, settlement, vacatur, petition), then stops.

remittitur_scenarios.note: D4: declared scenarios, shown side by side and never weighted. The remit branch (J2 = remit, Q2 = accept) takes the selected scenario's amount for the compensatory component; the verdict-stands scenario prices the remit branch at the verdict.

remitted.label: Remitted to the most the evidence supports
remitted.basis: Bennis's method with Irwin's revenue corrections (D.I. 616-1, tr. 1698-1700, 2346-47)

fee_scenarios.note: D4 (a): the requested amount if fees are awarded (J5), otherwise $0. No ratio is applied (the only ratio source post-dates the decision date).

settlement_scenarios.note: D5: the feasibility bound is available cash on the settlement date minus 30-day need, floored at 0 and capped at the path amount. Declared scenarios, never weighted. Non-cash terms are not booked. A paid settlement ends the dispute and removes the judgment-default trigger.

scenarios.lump_sum: the bound, paid on the settlement date
scenarios.monthly: the bound in equal monthly payments from the settlement date through the horizon

settlement_scenarios.asked: per interval: I1 before the ruling, I2 ruling to appeal deadline, I3 enforceable and unstayed, I4 stayed

rules: voluntary_payment_days_after_stay and enforcement_period_days (payment and levy dates follow the chain's milestones)
jev_nodes: forecast_amount_fixed and every ruling-timing question (Data timing)
forecast_secured_stay, forecast_security_form, forecast_voluntary_payment, forecast_enforcement_collects (replaced by the chain residuals)

removed_branches.basis: No notice of appeal can precede the last post-trial ruling (FRAP 4(a)(4)(A)); Federal Circuit schedules put any decision after the horizon.
Not filed by the decision date.
Removed on a path when the collateral exceeds available cash on every trajectory of that path at the stay decision; the stay then rests on J8 alone.
Removed on a path when the amount owed exceeds available cash on every trajectory of that path at the decision date.

removed_branches.branch: pay the accelerated notes or the repurchase
removed_branches.basis: Removed when the principal exceeds available cash on every trajectory of the path.

removed_branches.ground: does not reach collections / window closed
removed_branches.basis: The line is below the $2.5M threshold; the first possible interest default is after the horizon.
No part-level revenue before the decision date (R8); one stress scenario only.

composition.ruling_chain_rule: P(outcome) = product of the merits answers along its branch, in order: liability, damages, remittitur election, patent, then trebling, fees and interest only where trade-secret money survives. Outcomes group into amount classes by arithmetic: none, each distinct amount within reach of available cash on some trajectory, and 'beyond reach' (above available cash on every trajectory), whose downstream cash is identical.

composition.neutral: Attribution step 2 sets every residual to neutral (a Noul at 0.5, a Choice uniform over the branches arithmetic leaves) and keeps everything the record fixes.
composition.paths_to_the_engine: Paths are sequences of decisions; each decision's effect is dated per trajectory and applies only where its condition holds on that date. A petition ends every later effect on its trajectory.
